input.title: 50bb · Flop · Broader ranges
input.description: A complete saved flop-to-river game on Qs 9h 6c, with a 32bb pot and 34bb behind. Broader starting ranges add top pairs, an underpair and additional sets to the earlier sets-and-draws study. Half-pot, pot, all-in and one subsequent raise are modeled across all three streets.
input.rangeAssumptions: Illustrative starting ranges: BTN QQ/QJs/T8s/AQs/TT and BB 99/JTs/QTs/66/A9s, equal weight per unblocked exact combination. These are declared study ranges, not outputs of a certified earlier betting line. Every later action and card arrival uses one jointly solved conditional flop-to-river game. This does not certify full-hand Hold'em. Rake-free Home game. Player 0 is BTN; player 1 is BB.
